status: Design only, for root/QA/ECO review; not an implementation authorization or release claim.
decisions: Explicit plan_refs is mandatory on each final internal claim; empty is allowed for direct recovery.
First output selects source propositions and inseparable qualifications, not polished prose or reasoning. The same span may contain several propositions; atomicity remains a semantic assertion.
Full original evidence, question, retained history, scope and annotation registry remain available in both calls. No plan-based retrieval, filtering or truncation.
All capacities are ceilings, never padding targets. Invalid shape/identity/size is a pipeline failure, not factual insufficient evidence.
Tentative version identities must be approved together with implementation; no implicit downgrade or response-key protocol inference.

reconstruction.response: planned_claim_supports_v1 with four_nullable_slots_v1 standard or status/paragraph brief

identity.binding: Pre-call cache/preparation binds exact original request/history/scope/evidence, both prompts, both generated wire schemas, full registry, immutable policy and all protocols. It cannot know a future generated plan. Final preparation additionally binds the exact validated compact plan bytes/hash. Recompute expected identity without trusting mutable cached maps.
identity.stale: Reject old/mixed versions, config, schemas, protocols, plans and cache identity before sensitive packet/key/native/ledger/provider access. Fresh changed-runtime acceptance is required.
identity.body: Source equality unwraps only the exact trusted phase wrapper. Reconstruct every original source character and metadata type; retain source/history order. The plan is a separate untrusted value and never replaces source text.

plan_contract.status: planned requires 1..8 points and 1..12 units. insufficient_evidence requires zero units and permits 0..8 points. Every mechanically valid plan, including empty/false insufficient, reaches the second call with full evidence.
plan_contract.point_consistency: supported has >=1 referring unit and no gaps. partial has >=1 referring unit and >=1 gap. missing has zero referring units and >=1 gap. An incomplete legal rule may still yield a partial point with an independently supported condition or procedure unit. These checks establish internal consistency only, not truth, coverage, absence or legal force.
plan_contract.integer_refs: unit.point is exactly an integer (not bool, float or numeric string) within actual point count. Final plan_refs are strict integers within actual unit count; fixed wire enum0..11 is not local authorization.
plan_contract.labels: need is nonblank, at most96 UTF-8 bytes after strict decoding. Reject U+0000..001F and U+007F..009F only; do not reject ordinary multilingual Unicode. Preserve exact text and order, with no trim, normalization, case-fold, transliteration, truncation or repair. Local maxLength96 is supplementary; byte enforcement is mandatory.
plan_contract.gaps: At most4 distinct known codes. Added generic support code explicitly represents generally missing evidence; other codes remain subject,predicate,antecedent,procedure,reference,scope,date,quantity,currentness,source_access. Codes and coverage do not establish absence.
plan_contract.duplicates: Duplicate point labels and repeated point indexes across units are allowed. Repeated whole units are allowed and count separately. Same selector in primary and a link or under different link roles is allowed; each occurrence counts toward10 and48. Reject an exact repeated role+selector linked-support pair, regardless of key ordering. Never merge or deduplicate stored plan data. Duplicate final plan_refs are rejected; their submitted order is preserved, not sorted.
plan_contract.source_resolution: Resolve every selector through the exact original registry and original payload. Check source ownership using passage/source association, not role or kind. Primary must resolve to substantive passage text. Keep existing exact field/text membership, nonblank and1..600-character quote bounds. IDs are case-sensitive. Every selected source_publication span must equal its full canonical label.
plan_contract.context: For every cited passage in each unit, select actual text for all declared context_ids in that same unit, including dependencies of any newly cited context passages. Verify visible context mapping equals original prepared evidence; no fabricated headers or metadata substitutes.
plan_contract.publication: Each unit selects the canonical full publication label for each distinct cited source record with represented publication metadata, including sources cited only as context. One selected label may serve same-source passage citations within that unit. Source labels do not cross ownership. Unknown/conflicting/invalid metadata labels remain unresolved. No first-pass prose acknowledgement exists.
plan_contract.serialization: Compact validated plan is JSON ensure_ascii=false, separators comma/colon, preserving decoded object insertion and array order. Measure actual encoded UTF-8 bytes including escaping, not sum of label bytes. Do not reorder, canonicalize or repair data to fit. Store raw strict-parsed plan and validated compact plan separately with hashes.

final_contract.shape: Public answer/status/envelope remains unchanged. Internal claim adds mandatory plan_refs before primary_support, supports and text in the schema. Shared definitions factor selector enums without changing source identity. Exact standard/brief wire+local files are included; registry values are replaced in original insertion order for each prepared request.
reference_algorithm: Use the exact validated plan already hash-bound into final preparation. Unit identity is its original array position.

Require a list of distinct strict integers within the actual unit count. Empty list is valid even for a zero-unit plan. Fixed enum0..11 avoids an invalid empty wire enum; local validation rejects every nonempty ref against a zero-unit plan.

Resolve final own-claim selectors against the original registry with unchanged ownership/primary/context rules. Construct required union of all referenced units' primary and linked (citation_id,span_id) pairs. Roles have no special authority.

Require every exact pair in that claim's own selector set. An equivalent source alias, a sibling claim or a paragraph-level support does not satisfy this narrow retention invariant. Claim primary need not equal each referenced primary when units are combined.
Compare using sets only for the invariant; preserve submitted order, multiplicity, text and selectors in capture. Never auto-add a missing selector or rewrite a claim.

Only after successful validation, explicitly adapt by removing plan_refs. Send identical remaining claim representation into all existing final normalization/public guards. Verify identical claim text hashes and paragraph assembly offsets.
final_contract.direct_path: Use plan_refs for units actually drawn on. Empty refs permit recovery from incomplete/incorrect plans and unplanned full evidence, never permission to omit source conditions. This intent is a prompt/semantic rule, not a keyword heuristic or forced-ref metric. A direct claim may still be wrong; all final guards and semantic review remain.
final_contract.publication_sharing: Referenced unit publication selectors necessarily recur in the referencing claim because they are part of the exact subset. This does not impose per-claim publication labels on all direct claims: unchanged final paragraph-local sharing still applies. Every cited source needs its proper label and year attribution in that paragraph under existing guards.
final_contract.unchanged_limits: At most10 selectors per claim including primary and10 distinct resolved (citation_id,field,quote) tuples per paragraph, standard1..4 contiguous slots with350-word instruction, brief1 paragraph up to3 short sentences target50 maximum80. Claim/paragraph model text limit6000 stays unchanged. Plan48 is not a promise that48 required supports fit4x10 or brief10. No automatic split, crop or weakened acceptance; capacity failure is honestly reported.
final_contract.semantic_limits: Retained selectors do not prove subject/antecedent completion, quantity scope, modality, linked-duty retention, exclusivity, publication attribution, current legal force or requested coverage. No hardcoded legal keyword filter, string-matching entailment claim, third judge or answer repair.

guard_mapping.existing: Strict JSON and trusted envelope context
guard_mapping.first_plan: Keep raw65536/depth32/duplicate-key/nonfinite/surrogate checks. Explicit plan-protocol context and exact schema/keys/status consistency replace prose envelope, without response-shape inference.
guard_mapping.final: Existing final envelope plus explicit planned-claim protocol; no mixed/downgraded schema.

guard_mapping.first_plan: Transport scans real credentials before payload-bearing callbacks; strict decode precedes decoded-payload callbacks. Raw plan labels are not public/tracing data. Record only after the same credential and protocol boundary.
guard_mapping.final: Unchanged credential/scanner ordering, including plan-bearing wrapper/capture.

guard_mapping.first_plan: Exact source payload, registry, scope, history, prompt/schema, version and full encoded-message equality before reservation/dispatch.
guard_mapping.final: All same evidence plus validated plan hash bound before second reservation.

guard_mapping.first_plan: Use plan-specific provenance checks with exact resolution, represented fields, contexts and canonical publications. Do not fabricate a sentence to pass the old native prose unit validator. Reuse/extract pure guard logic only with explicit tests.
guard_mapping.final: Unchanged final source/native/public guards after explicit internal-field adapter.

guard_mapping.first_plan: Prose-only Paragraph/GroundedAnswer/citation_text equality, paragraph count, paragraph publication-year wording and public display validation are inapplicable. Replace with plan schema, bounds, status consistency and provenance checks; do not claim they ran.
guard_mapping.final: All existing guards remain, including native/public status/content rules, source labels/year presence, citation_text identity, assembly and text limits.

guard_mapping.first_plan: Distinguish raw parsed, validation/resolution complete/failed and validated compact plan. Preserve point/unit indices, every selector/role, planhash and count boundaries. No fabricated prose offsets for labels.
guard_mapping.final: Capture refs/planhash/required-present-missing selectors as retention evidence only; preserve text assembly hashes. No labels/refs leak to public answer or cached public output.

failure_sequence: Preflight trusted config/protocol, original source identity, both generated schemas and first messages within bounds before first reservation. Preserve existing max pair preflight.

After first call, strict parse/credentials/context/provenance/shape/count/byte checks must all pass before second reservation. Malformed plans cannot become empty plans or factual insufficient evidence.

Prepare second messages from complete sources plus exact validated plan; enforce full encoded(messages)<=36000 and schema<=4096 before second reservation. Any first-stage cost remains recorded on later failure.
A mechanically valid insufficient plan proceeds; only a validated final answer may be published/cached.
No retries, fallbacks, third calls, schema repair, answer repair or unreviewed changes to budgets/timeouts.
fit_and_acceptance: size-report.json measures exact frozen prompts, three generated wire schemas and both fully encoded message styles using a matching fictional registry, including escaped and multilingual labels. It is not actual-corpus fit.

ECO must independently measure exact prompts/schemas against root-authorized retained inputs, including a conservative maximum plan for actual identifier shapes, before any paid dispatch. Full8192 compact allowance and escaping are reported separately; it is not guaranteed to fit all legal first-message payloads.
Cold schema compilation/provider format acceptance and latency remain unverified. Do not assume a warm cache or make a free warmup.
After reviewed prototype, retain all71 unchanged semantic cases and3 HTTP journeys, including useful partial answers and excessive abstention. Prior passing v9 outputs do not transfer.
Root alone owns paid dispatch/accounting, native evidence, preview/live/API/browser, merge/deploy. This design performs none of those.

schema_compatibility.summary: Wire files use closed objects, scalar enums, internal refs and anyOf; only final claims uses minItems1. Unsupported maximum/minimum/string-length/max-array constraints stay in local schemas/checks, with explicit descriptions. No unreviewed SDK transform. Provider acceptance and cold-compilation timing remain untested.
schema_compatibility.local_note: Local JSON schemas are necessary structural descriptions, not complete validators. Status/reference/UTF8/ownership/context/publication/global-count/compact-byte checks are separately mandatory in this contract.

artifacts: All files except manifest.json are content-hashed in manifest.json; exact prompt files have no trailing newline. JSON files use compact UTF-8 serialization. build.py and seal.py are offline design utilities, not proposed production code.
open_review_items: Approve exact prompts, schema factoring and additional generic support gap code as one frozen contract.
Validate strict point coverage/gap consistency does not suppress independently supported partial conditions. Labels remain untrusted.
Confirm per-unit publication bundle retention tradeoff versus existing paragraph-local sharing for direct claims.
Review capacity refusal risk, exact actual input bounds and selected first/final phase wrapper keys before prototype.
